verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.squareup.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a clear agent-oriented description of the platform, and Square also documents an official MCP server, giving agents multiple structured entry points into its docs. missing for 10: no docs.md/markdown-per-page fallback (404) and no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec discoverable at standard paths, so coverage beyond the root llms.txt is unproven.
